endpoints.summary: Record a durable candidate refill request
endpoints.description: Idempotently records a Music Library consumption event in the unreviewed candidate queue. Requests remain held until explicitly dispatched after research and capacity gates.

endpoints.description: Cancels a held refill request using its stable source reservation identity.

endpoints.summary: Inspect durable Music Library result forwarding state.

endpoints.summary: Queue a hash-bound audio remix
endpoints.description: Queue a CPU transformation of one exact managed source excerpt. The successful job records an immutable source/output hash receipt; no generative model is selected.

rest_exception.note: This local job ingress carries managed blob identity, exact hashes and bounded time ranges; its evolving receipt is an owner REST contract.

endpoints.summary: Queue a hash-bound sample arrangement
endpoints.description: Queue a CPU sample arrangement by repeating one exact managed excerpt. The successful job records an immutable source/output hash receipt; no generative model is selected.

rest_exception.note: This local job ingress carries managed blob identity, exact hashes and bounded time ranges; its evolving receipt is an owner REST contract.

endpoints.summary: Stream owner-verified transformation audio
endpoints.description: Stream only the derived WAV whose bytes match the successful Music Tools job receipt; supports private byte-range review.

rest_exception.note: The listening room needs byte-range access to the exact derived output, whose content hash is checked before streaming.
